official_definition: Ultimate Unsheathe (When Summoned) You can summon as many braves in the family Exalted Sword from your hand as you would like, up to a total cost of 7. When a brave is summoned due to this effect, draw one card from your deck.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultimate Unsheathe] or [Ultimate Unsheathe: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultimate Unsheathe]", "give [Ultimate Unsheathe]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
